topic.title: Controllable Image Editing and Semantic Evaluation
topic.overview: Image editing and generation must satisfy instructions while preserving relevant details, relationships, and identity. This topic combines compositional benchmarks, large editing datasets, multimodal planning, and evaluation of aesthetics or semantic knowledge. A visually pleasing image can still violate the requested change.
topic.whyItMatters: Reliable assessment needs to distinguish instruction adherence, preservation, and visual quality. Cross-modal models add another challenge: knowledge that changes a text response may not reach the pathway controlling generated imagery.
topic.evolution: The collection includes earlier studies of image memorability and controlled generation. Recent work builds compositional text-to-image and multi-turn editing benchmarks. A newer cross-modal editing study exposes a substantial gap between successful textual edits and visual generation. These findings encourage evaluations tied to specific requested relationships rather than a single global image-quality score.
openQuestions: How can evaluation verify both the intended edit and preservation of unrelated content?
What makes a knowledge update transfer consistently from language to image generation?

papers.title: FineGRAIN: Evaluating Failure Modes of Text-to-Image Models with Vision Language Model Judges

papers.title: Flow-GRPO: Training Flow Matching Models via Online RL

papers.title: FOCUS: Unified Vision-Language Modeling for Interactive Editing Driven by Referential Segmentation

papers.title: Hallucination at a Glance: Controlled Visual Edits and Fine-Grained Multimodal Learning
papers.tldr: Controlled image edits and a consistency-based training objective improve subtle visual difference detection and reduce multimodal hallucinations.

papers.title: ImgEdit: A Unified Image Editing Dataset and Benchmark

papers.title: InstanceAssemble: Layout-Aware Image Generation via Instance Assembling Attention

papers.title: IntrinsiX: High-Quality PBR Generation using Image Priors

papers.title: KRIS-Bench: Benchmarking Next-Level Intelligent Image Editing Models
papers.tldr: KRIS-Bench tests knowledge-based reasoning in image editing and finds substantial gaps across nine leading models.

papers.title: LayerCraft: Enhancing Text-to-Image Generation with CoT Reasoning and Layered Object Integration
papers.tldr: LayerCraft coordinates language-model planning and layered object integration to support controllable image generation and iterative editing without retraining.

papers.title: Learning to Generate Human-Human-Object Interactions from Textual Descriptions

papers.title: LinEAS: End-to-end Learning of Activation Steering with a Distributional Loss
papers.tldr: LinEAS learns coordinated linear activation edits across layers to steer generation effectively from a handful of unpaired samples.

papers.title: LMFusion: Adapting Pretrained Language Models for Multimodal Generation
papers.tldr: LMFusion adds trainable image modules to pretrained language models, enabling multimodal generation while retaining language capabilities.

papers.title: LoRAShop: Training-Free Multi-Concept Image Generation and Editing with Rectified Flow Transformers
papers.tldr: LoRAShop uses concept-specific spatial masks to combine existing LoRA models for multi-concept image generation and editing without retraining.

papers.title: MJ-Bench: Is Your Multimodal Reward Model Really a Good Judge for Text-to-Image Generation?

papers.title: MMIG-Bench: Towards Comprehensive and Explainable Evaluation of Multi-Modal Image Generation Models
papers.tldr: MMIG-Bench unifies multimodal image-generation evaluation with layered metrics for fidelity, instruction alignment, aesthetics, and human preference.

papers.title: Musings on AI Muses: Support for Human Creativity
papers.tldr: The paper explores AI muses that support human creativity through encouragement, critique, and reflection, generating substantial content when requested.

papers.title: OmniGen-AR: AutoRegressive Any-to-Image Generation

papers.title: OneIG-Bench: Omni-dimensional Nuanced Evaluation for Image Generation
papers.tldr: OneIG-Bench evaluates image generators across content alignment, text rendering, reasoning, style, and diversity.

papers.title: Opt-In Art: Learning Art Styles Only from Few Examples
papers.tldr: A model pretrained only on photographs can learn artistic styles from a few examples and match evaluated art-pretrained models after adaptation.

papers.title: ORIGEN: Zero-Shot 3D Orientation Grounding in Text-to-Image Generation
papers.tldr: ORIGEN uses reward-guided noisy sampling to control multiple objects' 3D orientations in text-to-image generation without task-specific training.

papers.title: OverLayBench: A Benchmark for Layout-to-Image Generation with Dense Overlaps
papers.tldr: OverLayBench and OverLayScore make dense object overlap a systematic test of layout-to-image generation.

papers.title: PairEdit: Learning Semantic Variations for Exemplar-based Image Editing

papers.title: PolyVivid: Vivid Multi-Subject Video Generation with Cross-Modal Interaction and Enhancement
papers.tldr: PolyVivid aligns subject images with text and injects fused identity features into video generation to improve multi-subject consistency and realism.

papers.title: Preventing Shortcuts in Adapter Training via Providing the Shortcuts

papers.title: Real-Time Intuitive AI Drawing System for Collaboration: Enhancing Human Creativity through Formal and Contextual Intent Integration

papers.title: RelationAdapter: Learning and Transferring Visual Relation with Diffusion Transformers
papers.tldr: RelationAdapter learns an editing relationship from source–target image pairs and transfers it to new images.

papers.title: Rendering-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Vector Graphics Generation
